meta.title: Revised Lba Cra And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Approve LBA Resolution 1 of 2026, adopting the tentative budget for the Capital Projects Fund of the Local Building Authority of Salt Lake City, Utah for Fiscal Year 2026-27.
votes.description: Adopts the tentative budget for the LBA's Capital Projects Fund for FY2026-27, which covers bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries. The LBA serves as a financing tool to allow government entities to bond for capital projects at better interest rates.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Board of the Local Building Authority and reconvene as the Community Reinvestment Agency.
votes.description: Procedural motion to close the LBA meeting and transition the body to convene as the CRA Board.

votes.motion: Approve CRA Resolution 5 of 2026, adopting the tentative budget for the Community Reinvestment Agency of Salt Lake City for Fiscal Year 2026-27.
votes.description: Adopts the tentative budget for the Community Reinvestment Agency for FY2026-27. This resolution sets the framework for CRA funding and project expenditures for the coming fiscal year.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Board of the Community Reinvestment Agency and reconvene as the Salt Lake City Council for a Formal Meeting.
votes.description: Procedural motion to close the CRA meeting and transition the body to convene as the Salt Lake City Council.

votes.motion: Approve the retreat meeting minutes of January 7, 2026, and the work session meeting minutes of January 20, 2026, February 10, 2026, and February 17, 2026, as well as the formal meeting minutes of January 20, 2026, and February 3, 2026.
votes.description: Approves multiple prior meeting minutes from the City Council, covering retreat and work session meetings in January and February 2026 as well as two formal meeting minutes.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer items G-1 through G-4 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the joint public hearing on four grant applications (COPS Technology/Equipment, Utah Outdoor Recreation, SHPO Cemetery, and Emergency Management Performance grants) and refers them to a future consent agenda for formal action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Fortune Road Partial Street Vacation ordinance to a future Council Meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed vacation of a portion of Fortune Road (approximately 2040 West to Wallace Road) and defers action on the ordinance to a future meeting. The right-of-way, if vacated, would be sold to the petitioner at fair market value.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Mansell Manor Zoning Map Amendment ordinance to a future Council Meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed rezone of 1726 South Jefferson Street and a portion of 1750 South Jefferson Circle from MU-11 and RMF-35 to MU-8, and defers action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Resolution 2 of 2026, honorarily renaming the City-owned portion of 500 South between State Street and 700 East 'Dolores Huerta Boulevard.'
votes.description: Closes the public hearing and adopts the resolution to honorarily rename a stretch of 500 South as Dolores Huerta Boulevard, recognizing the American labor leader and activist who co-founded the National Farm Workers Association.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Camping or Obstructing Public Property and Park Rules Text Amendment ordinance to a future Council Meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed ordinance amending city code relating to camping on public grounds, park hours, and obstructing sidewalks, and defers action to a future meeting pending further deliberation.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on the Master Plan and Zoning Map Amendment at approximately 346, 350, 354, and 370 South 800 East, and 775 East 400 South to a future Council Meeting.
votes.description: Continues the public hearing on a proposed rezone of properties from RMF-35 to MU-5 and a General Plan Future Land Use Map amendment for a mixed-use development with 109 residential units, deferring further consideration to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Establish a working group of Council Members Carlsen, Dugan, and Wharton to retain an independent investigator to conduct an investigation of allegations regarding Council Member Lopez Chavez and any potential violations of the Code of Conduct, with an intention to conclude before end of July 2026.
votes.description: Creates a three-member Council working group to oversee an independent investigation into allegations of Code of Conduct violations by Council Member Lopez Chavez, with a target completion before the end of July 2026.

votes.motion: Temporarily suspend Council Member Lopez Chavez's duties of conducting formal meetings, CRA leadership role, City-related travel, speaking on behalf of the Council, and use of communications budget to communicate about the investigation, while the investigation is underway.
votes.description: Temporarily removes certain official duties and privileges from Council Member Lopez Chavez pending the outcome of the independent Code of Conduct investigation established in the preceding motion.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 9 of 2026, adopting the tentative budget of Salt Lake City, including the tentative budget of the Library Fund for Fiscal Year 2026-27.
votes.description: Adopts the tentative City budget for FY2026-27, including the Library Fund budget, incorporating the Mayor's proposed $498.9 million general fund budget and a proposed 12.5% property tax increase.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda, except for Item L-4, Board Appointment related to the Housing Authority of Salt Lake City – Turner Bitton.
votes.description: Approves all consent agenda items including setting public hearing dates for two ordinances, the board appointment of Deborah Chiquito to the Housing Authority, and the reappointment of Joseph Murphy to the CDCIP Advisory Board, while pulling the Turner Bitton appointment for a future meeting.
